comment: The pinned SDK emits the registered JWT client_id claim in addition to aud/azp. OIDC Core permits additional claims. Package tests assert the complete allowed claim set; user attributes and credentials are not exposed.

Authkit has a name and optional image, not birthdate, gender, nickname, timezone or the rest of the optional profile attributes. Core 5.4 permits omitting unavailable information. No synthetic claims are invented.

The provider does not define ACR assurance classes and does not advertise acr_values_supported. It returns actual authentication methods in amr and does not invent a class for the arbitrary requested values 1 and 2.
The optional claims request parameter is not supported or advertised. Name is returned for profile scope; this test asks for it through claims while requesting only openid.
